messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected — elevated 5xx (503) rate on /v1/embeddings (staged rollout) in eu-west-1.  p50 latency OK, error rate 8% -> 22% over last 3m. Trigger: rollout-health-check. Runbook: <https://redwood/runbooks/deploy-failures|deploy-failures>.

alex.k: seeing it too, thx. Which release is staged?

maria.p: staged rollout v2026.03.15-embed-quant → 10% traffic to variant q4. Metrics: errors correlate with kv-cache misses and OOM-ish logs on worker-3. Customer impact: a handful of enterprise customers saw failed emb calls during batch jobs (retries masking some).

ben.t: grabbing recent logs now. quick grep:
```
2026-03-15T21:06:12Z worker-3 embeddings request failed: status=503 err="executor OOM, fallback triggered" model=q4 quant=8bit
2026-03-15T21:06:13Z worker-3 restart attempt 1
```

alex.k: can we flip the FF for the staged variant (traffic -> base model) as kill switch? prefer flip before rollback if quick. impact: would drop q4 traffic immediately.

maria.p: agree. estimated blip < 1m. Ben, can you execute kill?

ben.t: running command now: `./deployctl feature-toggle set embeddings.q4_staged false --env=prod --region=eu-west-1`

incident-bot: Command acknowledged by deployctl. Action recorded: toggle embeddings.q4_staged -> false by ben.t at 2026-03-15T21:07:10Z.

maria.p: monitoring... error rate trending down to 6% in eu-west-1 within 30s :white_check_mark:  p95 latency stable.

alex.k: good. Do we need full rollback or is kill-switch sufficient?

ben.t: kill-switch removed the immediate pressure. I still see elevated mem pressure on worker-3 (maybe leaked state after quant kernel). Suggest drain and reprovision that host. Will open a node drain job.

riley.oncall: I'm taking handoff for the night. summary: staged q4 quant variant caused OOM-like failures on some workers under embedding batch load in eu-west-1; kill-switch toggled to remove variant traffic; errors reduced. Next actions: drain worker-3, reprovision, run canary against small traffic, add ephemeral alert for mem > 80% on embedding workers.

riley.oncall: adding runbook checklist I did: 1) verify kill-switch persisted, 2) drain host-3, 3) reprovision and monitor 30m, 4) follow-up postmortem. Link to checklist: <https://redwood/checklists/fflag-deploy-handoff|fflag-deploy-handoff>.

maria.p: note for postmortem: capture KV-cache miss distribution + kernel patch applied in v2026.03.15. Also include customer impact table (IDs: C-239, C-442 had retries >3).

alex.k: tagging platform-eng to bubble this into model-onboarding tests — maybe add a stress test for quant variant under batch embeddings. @shilpa (cc)

ben.t: created incident ticket INC-20260315-embed-q4 and linked to rollout. allocated owner: ben.t. Severity: Sev2 (partial degradation, some customer retries).

incident-bot: Paging rotation notice: @riley.oncall is now oncall for this incident. If escalation required, page #eng-sre.

riley.oncall: I'll follow up with a short status update to customers impacted via CSMs once worker is reprovisioned and stable. Leaving note here: will check again in 15m and 45m. :eyes:

alex.k: thanks all. Marking thread as monitoring. If anything regresses, re-open pager.

maria.p: monitoring window 45m started at 2026-03-15T21:07:40Z. Keeping logs and graphs exported to the incident ticket.

ben.t: drain job kicked: `k8s drain worker-3 --grace=60s && kubectl delete pod -l worker=worker-3` — reprovision pipeline triggered.

riley.oncall: acknowledged. updating status: mitigated -> monitoring. will update ticket after 30m. :white_check_mark:
